Reconciler severity downgrade BLOCKER->CONCERN: size+mtime re-stat does not bind the renamed pathname to the hashed inode; with a safe quarantine dir the residual is a reversible move, not data loss.
evidence: scripts/clean_experiment_downloads.py:2293-2317 (hash on O_NOFOLLOW fd of inode A; re-stat compares size+mtime only at :2303; rename resolves the pathname again). The race is real but the plan REGISTERED exactly this mechanism (plan v3 gate 7: pre-rename re-stat size+mtime, the _reap_scratch_tree fresh-recheck idiom), the kill criterion's 'proves unsafe' trigger is not met once uvproj-quarantine-destination-unsafe is fixed (worst case: an adversarial same-size mtime-preserving same-UID swap gets its bytes reversibly MOVED into a private 0700 dir with a stale evidence string; a benign mid-write race is caught by re-stat + the 600s grace). Recommended fix alongside the blocker: compare os.fstat(fd).st_dev/st_ino against a fresh lstat(cand) immediately before rename and abort to tmp-uvproj-reap-aborted-recency on mismatch; else adopt the plan's escalate-only fallback.
